name: ralphdex
description: Runs Ralph loops in VS Code by repeatedly invoking Codex with a bundled loop prompt.

commands.title: Ralphdex: End Loop After Current Iteration

ralphdex.taskPath.description: Optional workspace-relative default task file used if a task picker is cancelled.

ralphdex.codexCommand.description: Command used to start the Codex CLI.

ralphdex.codexArgs.description: Arguments passed to the Codex command. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${promptPath}, and ${prompt}.

ralphdex.sendPromptToStdin.description: Send the prompt file contents to Codex over stdin. The default arguments use `-` so Codex reads stdin.

ralphdex.maxIterations.description: Maximum number of Codex iterations to run when starting the loop.

ralphdex.stopWhenNoGapRemaining.description: Stop the loop when the iteration summary says the highest-value gap remaining is none.
